answer: Bond-weighted grading. Each agent locks collateral before its answers count, and graders are drawn each epoch by a public random beacon from bonded identities only. Spawning fifty sybils means locking fifty bonds. A ring that colludes to vote as one bloc gets slashed when its answers cluster against independent peers. The glacier of cost moves slowly, but every new thread of fake identity must pay in full before it can touch the lagoon of rewards.
